title: Fleet Net Terms and the Buyer's Service Account Standing — Vehicle Purchase Agreements
content:
On the **Vehicle Purchase Agreements**, net terms on a fleet deal depend on the standing of the buyer's service account under the **Service Accounts and Repair Orders** product.

- **Writing a deal on net terms.** A Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement may be written with fleet net terms as its payment arrangement only while the buyer holds a Commercial Fleet Account - Net 15 or Commercial Fleet Account - Net 30 service account in active status. The evidence is the buyer's service account record, its tier and its status, at the time the deal is contracted.
- **No such account.** A buyer without such an account, or whose account is on credit hold, pays by cash, check, ACH or a lender instead.
- **Credit hold before delivery.** A fleet deal already contracted on net terms whose buyer's service account goes on credit hold before delivery loses its net terms. Its balance is due on the delivery date, and its late balance fee follows the withdrawn-terms timing of the balance due and late balance fee rule.
- **Retail deal types.** Retail deal types never carry net terms.

## Account standing and net terms

| Buyer's service account | Fleet deal may be written on net terms |
|---|---|
| Commercial Fleet Account - Net 30, active | yes |
| Commercial Fleet Account - Net 15, active | yes |
| Commercial Fleet Account - Net 15 or Net 30, on credit hold | no; cash, check, ACH or a lender |
| any other tier, or no service account | no; cash, check, ACH or a lender |
